title: Agreement of runs on truncated inputs
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine over an alphabet $\Gamma$, let $x$ be an input word, and let $m\in\mathbb{N}$. For every choice word $w$, configuration $c$ on input $x$, and configuration $c'$ on the truncated input consisting of the first $m$ symbols of $x$, suppose $c$ and $c'$ have equal states, input-head positions, work tapes, work-tape head positions, and outputs, and the input-head position of $c$ plus $|w|$ is at most $m+1$. Then the runs from $c$ and $c'$ under $w$ agree in all five of these components: state, input-head position, work tapes, work-tape head positions, and output.
